integrity: The proof is reconstructed directly from the slice definitions. The Delta lower bound uses a transverse boundary witness inside every slice containing the axis point; the upper bound is a one-variable optimization on a coordinate slice. The literature comparison is statement-based, and novelty remains subject to unindexed equivalent formulations.
limitations: The theorem is for real scalar-axis points in R plus_p Y with 1<p<infinity and Y nonzero. It does not claim a general-point formula, a complex-scalar analogue, or the p=infinity case. The packaged checker samples only integer exponents; the theorem for real p is analytic.
title: Exact scalar-axis Daugavet and \(\Delta\)-constants in \(\ell_p\)-sums
